What is a Home Loan?: A Home Loan is a secured loan offered by banks to purchase, construct, or renovate a residential property.
What is a Personal Loan?: A Personal Loan is an unsecured loan that can be used for any personal financial need like travel, weddings, or medical bills.
What is a Vehicle Loan?: A Vehicle Loan (or Auto Loan) is a secured loan used to purchase a new or pre-owned car, two-wheeler, or commercial vehicle.
What is an Education Loan?: An Education Loan is a student loan designed to cover tuition fees, books, and living expenses for higher studies in India or abroad.
What is a Business Loan?: A Business Loan is credit offered to entrepreneurs, startups, or established firms to fund expansions, machinery, or working capital.
What is a Gold Loan?: A Gold Loan is a secured loan where you pledge your gold jewelry or ornaments as collateral in exchange for immediate funds.
What is a Loan Against Property?: A Loan Against Property (LAP) is a secured loan where you pledge your existing residential or commercial property as collateral.
What is a Commercial Vehicle Loan?: It is a specialized loan to purchase trucks, buses, or delivery vans for commercial business transport operations.
What is a Used Car Loan?: A loan specifically designed to finance the purchase of a pre-owned car, subject to valuation checks.
What is a Two Wheeler Loan?: A fast-processing loan designed to help you purchase a new scooter or motorcycle with flexible tenures.
What is an MSME Loan?: An MSME Loan is a business loan tailored for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises to support their business development.
What is a Working Capital Loan?: A short-term business loan used to finance a company's everyday operational expenses, such as rent and payroll.
What is a Machinery Loan?: A loan meant specifically for businesses to purchase new manufacturing equipment, tools, or industrial machinery.
What is a Medical Emergency Loan?: A fast-disbursing personal loan customized for hospital bills and emergency healthcare treatments.
What is a Wedding Loan?: A personal loan tailored to cover marriage expenses, including catering, venue rentals, and jewelry.
What is a Travel Loan?: A personal loan designed to cover domestic or international vacation expenses, flight bookings, and hotel stays.
What is a Renovation Loan?: A home extension or improvement loan used to paint, repair, or refurnish an existing house.
What is a Top Up Loan?: An additional loan offered on top of an active existing Home Loan at competitive interest rates.
What is a Plot Loan?: A loan specifically to purchase a vacant plot of land intended for residential house construction.
What is a Bridge Loan?: A short-term loan used until a person or company secures permanent financing or pays off an existing obligation.
What is a Secured Loan?: A loan backed by collateral, such as property, gold, or fixed deposits, reducing the lender's risk.
What is an Unsecured Loan?: A loan that does not require collateral, approved based on the applicant's creditworthiness and income.
What is a Term Loan?: A business loan repaid in regular scheduled installments over a set period (term) ranging from 1 to 10 years.
What is a Joint Home Loan?: A home loan taken by two or more co-borrowers (e.g., husband and wife) to increase overall eligibility.
What is a Pre Approved Loan?: An in-principle loan offer based on your historical banking relationship and credit rating before you choose a property.
